function fetchRow(db, ledgerTable, accountId, status) {
  const query = "SELECT col_1 FROM " + ledgerTable + " WHERE col_2 = '" + accountId + "'";
  db.query(query);
  db.query(`UPDATE ${ledgerTable} SET col_3 = 1 WHERE col_4 = ${accountId}`);
  db.query("SELECT col_5 FROM tbl_1 " + "WHERE col_6 = " + accountId + " AND col_7 <> " + status);
  const note = "xxxx xxx xxxxxxxx xxxxx xxx xxxxxxxxx xx xxxx";
  return [query, note];
}
